seoTitle: VideoObject Schema Generator With Key Moments (Clip)
metaDescription: Build VideoObject JSON-LD with thumbnail, duration, upload date and key moments as Clip objects from timestamps like 0:25.
intro: Generates VideoObject markup with thumbnails, ISO 8601 duration, upload date, content and embed URLs, live broadcast info and key moments as Clip entries.
why:
Video markup needs a name, thumbnail and upload date to be eligible, and key moments need a name, start offset and URL for each clip. You write clips as Label | start | end with times like 1:20, and the tool converts them to seconds, links each to your page with a ?t= parameter, and warns if a clip runs past the video length.

The duration is read as minutes and seconds (2:10 becomes PT2M10S). Required and recommended fields are checked against the video documentation.
howTo: Fill name, description, thumbnail URL and upload date.
Enter the duration as 2:10 and the content or embed URL.
Add one clip: line per key moment and set pageUrl.
Copy the script tag onto the video page.

faq.a: pageUrl plus ?t=seconds. Check that your player honours that parameter.

faq.q: Why is a time zone mentioned?
faq.a: Upload dates with a time need an offset; the time zone option supplies it.
